name: Red Feather Fan
description: After you switch characters: Gain 1 stack of Efficient Switch and Agile Switch. (Once per Round)
descriptionraw: <color=#FFFFFFFF>After you switch characters:</color> Gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[K1041]</color> and <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[K1042]</color>. (Once per Round)
descriptionreplaced: <color=#FFFFFFFF>After you switch characters:</color> Gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Efficient Switch</color></color> and <color=#FFFFFFFF><color=#FFFFFFFF>Agile Switch</color></color>. (Once per Round)
storytext:
Legend has it that this fan is capable of unleashing various effects in the hands of a tengu warrior.
But in the hands of an ordinary person, it only possesses the power to "make one's body lighter."
Even so, this degree of power is more than useful for the average individual.
